name: mp4ff-bounded-hierarchical-parameter-set-parsing
instr:
Let callers bound the semantic complexity of attacker-controlled AVC and HEVC parameter sets with reusable finite or unlimited budgets. Apply one deterministic budget throughout nested codec parsing, decoder configuration, MP4 decoding, file and stream initialization, and inspection commands. Preserve all existing behavior when limits are omitted.

Every bounded parse consumes semantic collections atomically from one shared `ParseBudget`; a rejected debit consumes nothing, while earlier successful debits remain visible through `Remaining`. Every exhaustion is a `ParseLimitError` from `github.com/Eyevinn/mp4ff/bits`, with deterministic `Unit`, `Path`, `Requested`, and `Available` values and no path scopes leaked from earlier parses. AVC and HEVC charge only syntax that is present, while independently accounting for layer sets, extensions, profile and level sublayers, timing HRD parameters, HRD sublayers, CPB entries, and NAL and VCL arrays. Decoder configuration aggregates work across all VPS and SPS entries, and Reader and SliceReader decoding identify the same failing indexed entry. Existing entry points remain unlimited and preserve decoded values, accumulated physical read errors, bit positions, emulation prevention, partial results, and command output. The bits package exposes `ParseLimits`, `ParseBudget`, `NewParseBudget`, `ParseBudget.Remaining`, `ParseLimitError`, and `NewSliceReader`; avc exposes `ParseSPSNALUnitWithLimits`; hevc exposes `ParseVPSNALUnitWithLimits`, `
